# HAProxy — load-balancer-sse

Two backends with sticky sessions, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. Affinity has to hold both for the EventSource GET and for the separate client-to-server POSTs, and the frontend denies an upgrade with 501.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

HAProxy config (`haproxy/http/load-balancer-sse/vaadin.cfg`), mounted as
`conf.d/10-vaadin.cfg`:

```haproxy
# load-balancer plus a refusal to upgrade: two backends, sticky sessions, PUSH
# over Server-Sent Events.
#
# Affinity has to hold for both halves of SSE push — the EventSource GET that
# streams for the life of the connection, and the separate client-to-server XHR
# POSTs to the same path. Both carry the ROUTEID cookie, so both land on the
# backend that holds the session.
frontend vaadin-in from vaadin-front
    bind :80

    # HAProxy relays an upgrade with no configuration at all and has no keyword
    # to stop it, so the refusal is written out. The 501 comes from the proxy
    # rather than from Atmosphere.
    http-request deny deny_status 501 if { req.hdr(Upgrade) -m found }

    default_backend vaadin-app

backend vaadin-app from vaadin
    balance roundrobin
    cookie ROUTEID insert indirect nocache httponly
    server vaadin-1 vaadin-1:8080 cookie v1
    server vaadin-2 vaadin-2:8080 cookie v2
```

The `global` section, and the two `defaults` sections this file
inherits from, come from the shared
[haproxy-base.cfg](../../haproxy-base.cfg), mounted read-only beside
it as `conf.d/00-base.cfg`. Base and scenario only parse as a pair.
